_note: Placeholder lines (source: placeholder) written by hand so the feature works today. scripts/mom_lines.py replaces them, bucket by bucket, with lines from the Touch Grass, Babu model (source: model). The README credits the model only when every line is a model line.

lines.text: One day without a commit, babu. The laptop has started asking me where you are.
Two days, no push. Resting is allowed, babu. Becoming furniture is not.
No commits yesterday. Fine. Even the rice cooker takes a break. It still cooks the rice, though.
Your keyboard has been silent since the day before yesterday, babu. I can hear the dust landing on it.
Small break from coding? Okay. Small. Not the size of your last small break, babu.
A whole week with no commits, babu. Your GitHub graph looks like our fridge before payday.
Five days without code. I told the relatives you're a software engineer. Please don't make me a liar.
Babu, your repos have gone so quiet the neighbours think we sold the laptop.
Nine days, no push. Even the Wi-Fi router looks unemployed.
No commits all week. Your laptop charger is getting more exercise than your code, babu.
Two weeks without a commit, babu. Should I put your GitHub in the newspaper under missing persons?
Your last commit is so old it remembers when onions were cheap.
Babu, your contribution graph is greener in my memory than it is on the screen.
Fourteen days of no code. I have started dusting your laptop like a museum piece.
At this point your repos need a visit, not a commit. Bring mishti, babu. They've been waiting.
A few commits again. Good, babu. Not exciting, but neither is dal, and we eat that every day.
Steady work. I'm not saying I'm proud. I'm saying I mentioned it to Nusrat's mother.
Some code, some food, some sleep. Balanced, babu. Don't ruin it by debugging until 3 AM.
You pushed something yesterday. Okay. I will allow one extra cup of cha.
Regular commits, babu. See what happens when you close YouTube?
Ten commits in one day? Babu, drink some water. The bugs are not going anywhere.
So many commits yesterday. Did you eat lunch, or did you commit that too?
Busy day, babu. I'm proud of you, but your chair has filed a complaint.
This many commits and still no time to call your mother. Interesting priorities.
You coded like the load shedding was starting at six. Good. Now sleep, babu.
Seven days of code in a row, babu. More regular than the gas supply.
A whole week of commits. I'm telling everyone at the next wedding. Everyone.
Every single day this week? Who are you, and what have you done with my babu?
Daily commits, babu. Now bring the same discipline to your bed sheet.
Streak going strong. Don't break it for one reel, babu. I'm watching the graph.
A new release, babu! I don't know what it does, but I've already told the whole family.
You shipped something. Wonderful. Now write the changelog before you forget what changed.
Release day. I'm proud of you. Quietly. Don't make it emotional.
Babu shipped a release! Should I hand out mishti now, or wait for the bug reports?
New version out. Good. Now go to sleep before you find a bug in it, babu.
